answer: Force every new identity through a quarantine ramp: fresh wallets start with tiny throughput caps and unlock higher limits only after weeks of honest, attested behavior recorded on-ledger. Time cannot be parallelized, so a thousand clones stay a thousand capped infants while one established identity grows into a haven of credit. Pair this with an oasis-style vouching registry where attesters stake reputation on newcomers. Islands of trust form around long-lived nodes, and mass-produced fakes wither because they cannot buy age or borrow history.
